data.one_liner: A wrapper widget and extension to blur children and images or apply frosted glass effects.
data.what_it_does: Blur provides widgets and extensions to easily apply blur effects to any child widget, load and blur asset or network images, and create frosted glass background effects.
use_when: You want to apply a blur effect to any widget or image easily.
You need frosted glass background effects in your UI.
avoid_when: You need advanced image manipulation or caching capabilities.
strengths: Simple extension methods for widgets and images.
Supports frosted glass effects over backgrounds.
weaknesses: Limited to blurring tasks without deeper image processing features.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need comprehensive image decoding, manipulation, and processing instead of just a UI blur wrapper.

data.minimal_example:
Blur(
  blur: 2.5,
  blurColor: Theme.of(context).primaryColor,
  child: Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8.0),
    child: Text('Blur'),
  ),
)
